newIssues.title: On a phone, every soft-navigation loading ghost drops the top bar and the bottom dock, then the page jumps 60px
newIssues.width: ≤767 (390 measured); every L1 route's loading.tsx, including /visualizer and /company/materials
newIssues.repro: At 390 touch, go from /tasks via Tools › AI Visualizer, or from /company/profile via More › Company › Materials. Watch the chrome while the ghost shows.
newIssues.evidence: Unthrottled, three runs out of three: the top bar's computed display is 'none' for about 300ms (1350→1651 ms) while loading.tsx is on screen, then 'flex' again. With throttling, frames 32–38 show no top bar and no dock, and the ghost starts at y=0. When the page arrives, everything shifts down 60px. Cause: mobile-nav.module.css shows .bar/.dock only under body:has([data-om-l1-header]), and GhostSheet / the gallery ghosts' header bone carry no data-om-l1-header. A hard load is fine, because PageReveal's hidden content already carries the real header.
newIssues.fix: Put data-om-l1-header on the L1 ghosts' header row (VisualizerHomeGhost and MaterialsGhost .gHead, and CompanySkeleton and the other L1 ghosts), or give GhostSheet an l1 prop that sets it.
